bead.title: Preserve binary archives and aggregate release checksums
bead.description:
PROBLEM: Adding image and chart artifacts risks regressing the existing binary release output unless the binary packaging and checksum behavior are made explicit and aggregation-safe.

ROOT CAUSE: `scripts/release/package-binaries.sh:25` through `scripts/release/package-binaries.sh:39` builds and archives only `pqueue-verify-ledger`, and `scripts/release/package-binaries.sh:41` through `scripts/release/package-binaries.sh:45` rewrites `target/release-dist/SHA256SUMS` for the binary archive. `.github/workflows/release.yml:76` through `.github/workflows/release.yml:86` uploads whatever is in `target/release-dist` without validating the complete artifact set.

PROPOSED FIX: Keep `bash scripts/release/package-binaries.sh 0.2.0` compatible, add or refactor release checksum helpers so binary archives remain present while image evidence and chart packages are added, and add a manifest/static verification command that fails if binary archives or `SHA256SUMS` disappear.

GOVERNING ARTIFACTS: Parent bead `pqueue-3546063c`; `docs/helix/04-build/DEPLOYMENT-READINESS.md`; current `v0.1.0` release behavior in `scripts/release/package-binaries.sh`.

DEPENDENCY IDS: none supplied by parent.

NON-SCOPE: Creating a tag or GitHub release in this bead; final release execution is a separate bead.
bead.acceptance:
1. TestBinaryPackageDryRunPreserved: `bash scripts/release/package-binaries.sh 0.2.0` still produces `target/release-dist/pqueue-0.2.0-*.tar.gz` and `target/release-dist/SHA256SUMS` locally.
2. TestReleaseChecksumAggregation: after binary packaging plus chart/image evidence generation, `target/release-dist/SHA256SUMS` contains checksums for all file artifacts without dropping the binary archive entry.
3. TestReleaseArtifactSetVerification: a release verification script or workflow check fails when the binary archive, Helm chart package/evidence, image digest evidence, or checksum file is missing.
4. TestQualityGates: `go test ./...` and `lefthook run pre-commit` pass from the repository root alongside the package dry-run above.
